raw_sections.summary:
PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY
ServiceNow Developer with over 4.5 years of hands-on experience delivering scalable solutions across ITSM, Service Catalog, REST integrations, Platform Automation, and domain-separated architecture. Skilled in building enterprise-grade automations using Flow Designer, Workflows, Script Includes, and Business Rules. Strong background working across Incident, Request, Problem, Change, and custom applications, ensuring stable operations, optimized fulfillment flows, and reliable cross-platform eBonding integrations.
raw_sections.skills:
CORE SKILLS
ServiceNow Expertise:
○ Domain Separation Architecture ○ Service Catalog Engineering ○ Flow Designer & Workflow Automation
ITSM Modules (Incident, Request, Problem, Change)
Scripting & Configuration:
Business Rules, Script Includes, ACLs ○ Client Scripts, UI Policies, UI Actions ○ JSON Payload Engineering & Data Mapping

Integrations & Automation:
○ ○ Attachment Handling, eBonding Setup ○ Postman — API Validation & Debugging
Service Bridge (SN ↔ SN Integrations) Scripted REST APIs & Outbound REST
Analytics & Testing:
Platform Analytics Dashboards ○ Indicator Sources & KPIs ○ Automated Test Framework (ATF)
raw_sections.experience:
PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE
Cognizant Technology Solutions — Senior Infra Developer (ServiceNow) 21 Sep 2024 – Present
Delivered integrations across 10 customers, including ServiceNow ↔ ServiceNow (Service Bridge) and third-party systems like Freshservice, ManageEngine, and TOPdesk.
Designed scalable service catalog architectures.
Built multi-layered approval frameworks.
ServiceNow Platform Upgrade Experience: Supported ServiceNow platform upgrade activities, including upgrade testing, regression validation through ATF, configuration review, and ensuring custom applications and workflows remained stable across releases.
Platform Roadmap & Enhancement Planning: Contributed to the ServiceNow platform roadmap by identifying automation opportunities, prioritizing catalog and workflow enhancements, and planning scalable eBonding and ITSM improvements based on business requirements and platform needs.
Developed complex Business Rules and Script Includes. ● ● Created analytics dashboards with KPIs. ● Executed ATF regression suites.
Cognizant Technology Solutions — Programmer Analyst (ServiceNow) 24 Sep 2022 – 24 Sep 2024
Developed catalog items, UI policies, and configurations. ● Supported multiple ITSM enhancements.
Worked on platform issues, data fixes, and admin operations.
Cognizant Technology Solutions — ServiceNow Intern
31 Jan 2022 – 30 Apr 2022
Gained strong foundation in ServiceNow platform features. ● Participated in automation tasks and ITSM mini-projects.
raw_sections.projects:
PROJECTS
ON Target (July 2023 – Present): Hands-on development across catalog automation, workflows, and ebonding across multiple platforms.
Golden Image Project (August 2025 – Present):
Established full eBonding for all ITSM modules. ○ Configured bi-directional integration. ○ Developed approval-driven catalog solutions.
raw_sections.certifications:
CERTIFICATIONS
ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA) ● ServiceNow Certified Application Developer (CAD) ● ServiceNow Certified Implementation Specialist – ITSM
ServiceNow Certified Implementation Specialist – CSM
raw_sections.education:
EDUCATION
B.E in Mechanical Engineering, University Visvesvaraya College of Engineering, Bengaluru 2018 – 2022 | CGPA: 9.4
ServiceNow Micro-Certification
Flow Designer: Hands-on expertise in designing reusable flows, approval of workflows, automation, and sub flows using Flow Designer.
ServiceNow Micro-Certification – Performance Analytics: Experience building KPI dashboards, indicators, and analytics to monitor ITSM performance and SLA metrics.
Certification: ●
ITIL® 4 Foundation Certified – Strong understanding of ITIL service management principles, including Incident, Problem, Change, Request, and Service Management processes.
